title: ESR dates for the hominid burial site of Qafzeh in Israel
bibliographicNote: Read the original article, abstract, Table 1 and discussion. ESR on animal tooth enamel depends on uranium-uptake assumptions; the reported linear-uptake result is 115 ± 15 ka, compared with the cited TL mean of 92 ± 5 ka. The chapter does not assign all Qafzeh remains one exact date.
